method: Both reviewers viewed all160 originals in four contact sheets and all26 first-round replacements; originals inspected for distinctive matching details. No detector outputs used. Low quality and plain surfaces remain eligible. Physical books, art or signs remain eligible when scene or object geometry is visible; full-frame flat art/screens/text-designs are excluded symmetrically across classes.
